Depends on collecting items (several days); 1–2 hours for the crossbow

{npc:Elane}, leader of the paladins' guild in Thais, gives the addons of the {wiki:Hunter Outfits|Hunter Outfit}. For the Hooded Cloak (male) or Winged Tiara (female) you recover her crossbow from the hidden cult in Liberty Bay and hand over leather, enchanted wings and three pieces of steel. For the Sniper Gloves you just hand over a pair of {item:Sniper Gloves}. The quest also gives the achievement **Hunting with Style**.
A light, comfortable ranger outfit that all paladins love to wear. If you want to earn addons for this outfit, the Thais paladin guild is a good place to start.
Premium account (a Free account can only sell the Sniper Gloves to Elane for 2000 gold).
For the crossbow: have learned the **4 verses** of the {wiki:Hymn|Hymn} (with {item:Music Sheet|Music Sheets}) **and** have accepted Elane's task.
Engraved Crossbow, obtained in Liberty Bay's Cult Cave
the 4 verses of the Hymn, to reach the crossbow
to leave the Cult Cave through the entrance hole
The Hunter Outfit is available to everyone; only the addons are part of the quest.
All items except the crossbow can be gathered before talking to Elane. Collect them first.
The Hymn verses are very rare drops from the cultists; you can buy the Music Sheets from other players instead of hunting them.

Learn the 4 verses of the Hymn
To reach the crossbow you must have learned the 4 verses of the Hymn, using the {item:Music Sheet|Music Sheets}:
They are very rare drops. Buying the Music Sheets from other players is often quicker.
Go to the paladin guild in **Thais** and talk to {npc:Elane}: {key:hi}, {key:outfit}, {key:task}, {key:yes}. She explains what she needs; confirm with {key:yes}.
You must accept this task **before** going to the cult: without it you can't open the sealed door that leads to the crossbow chest.
3. Recovering Elane's Crossbow (Liberty Bay Cult Cave)
In all the images, the **flag** marks where you start and the **star** where you need to go.
Going to the cult's hidden cave

Go to the {wiki:Cult Cave (Liberty Bay)|hidden cult cave}, **north** of {wiki:Liberty Bay|Liberty Bay}, on the island of Vandura. The entrance is a hidden hole in the courtyard of one of the sheds **northeast** of the city; the cultists planted a {creature:Jungle Maw} near it. Go down the hole.
Cult Cave entrance (hole in the hut)
Path to the cult cave, north of Liberty Bay
After you enter, follow the path on the minimap.
Get ready for {creature:Tarantula|Tarantulas}, several {creature:Novice of the Cult|Novices of the Cult} and {creature:Witch|Witches}.

Keep following the map: you'll find more cultists, {creature:Bonelord|Bonelords} and Witches. At the end of the room there is a piano. If you have learned all the verses of the Hymn, use the piano to be teleported to the other side of the room.
Passing the sealed door and opening the chest

In this room there are {creature:Novice of the Cult|Novices}, {creature:Acolyte of the Cult|Acolytes} and {creature:Dark Monk|Dark Monks}. Follow the path to the chest, passing through a sealed door (it only opens if you have Elane's task). Open the chest and you receive the {item:Elane's Crossbow}.
Area runes such as {item:Thunderstorm Rune|Thunderstorm} and {item:Great Fireball Rune|GFB} are useful here.

Go back the same way to the room where the piano dropped you off: there is a teleport there that takes you back to the piano room. From there, follow the maps' paths in reverse to the entrance hole and climb up with the {item:Rope}. You come out in the shed northeast of Liberty Bay.
Without a {item:Rope} you can't climb up through the entrance hole.
Handing in the items in order
Go back to {npc:Elane} in Thais and hand in the items in this order, always confirming with {key:yes}:
100 Lizard Leather and 100 Red Dragon Leather
Piece of Royal Steel, Piece of Draconian Steel and Piece of Hell Steel
Kill {creature:Hunter|Hunters} until you get a pair of {item:Sniper Gloves} as a drop.
Male Hunter with the Sniper Gloves
Female Hunter with the Sniper Gloves
Take the gloves to {npc:Elane} (Thais) or {npc:Legola} (Carlin) and say {key:sniper gloves} and {key:yes}.
With a Free account Elane won't give you the addon: she offers you 2000 gold for the gloves. If you say {key:yes}, you lose the gloves.
This quest also gives the **Hunting with Style** achievement.

Dangers while collecting the items: Lizards, {creature:Dragon Lord|Dragon Lords}, all kinds of cultists of the {wiki:Voodoo Cult|Voodoo Cult}, {creature:Tarantula|Tarantulas}, {creature:Witch|Witches}, {creature:Bonelord|Bonelords}, {creature:Elder Bonelord|Elder Bonelords}, {creature:Dark Monk|Dark Monks} and {creature:Hunter|Hunters}.
